description: Starter checklist for FAA TSOA and aircraft TC/STC evidence planning. Exact TSO/MPS, project basis, applicant responsibilities and authority-agreed data determine the complete set. Guidance and orders do not replace regulations. Scope confirmation records a local review, not an FAA approval or authenticated signature.

subpartO.title: 14 CFR Part 21 Subpart O — TSO authorizations

8110-12.title: FAA Form 8110-12 — Application for TC, PC or STC

rows.title: Agreed basis, scope and complete compliance/data matrix
rows.help: List the exact standards/revisions, TSO and incorporated MPS where applicable, every applicable requirement and required data item, means of compliance, responsible party and evidence. Add requirements missing from this starter checklist as project-specific rows.

rows.title: Authority / aircraft applicant coordination record
rows.help: Record applicant, authority, designees, project references, proposed involvement, milestones, deliverables and agreed allocation of responsibilities. Supplier work location percentages inform discussion; they do not calculate FAA level of involvement.

rows.title: Identified product configuration and design data
rows.help: Identify article/system/software/hardware PNs, revisions, drawings, specifications and the configuration covered by compliance evidence. Account for variants and supplier inputs.

rows.title: Safety assessments and allocated assurance levels
rows.reference: Applicable certification basis and safety allocation
rows.help: Confirm required safety analyses, assumptions, installation interfaces, DAL allocations and limitations. Include supporting aircraft allocations for a supplier package.

rows.title: Software lifecycle evidence and accomplishment
rows.help: Link the required plans, standards, lifecycle/verification data, configuration index, quality/CM records and accomplishment summary. The exact set depends on the approved basis, software level and scope.

rows.title: Hardware lifecycle evidence and accomplishment
rows.help: Link applicable hardware plans, design/verification records, configuration index, quality/CM records and accomplishment summary. Confirm simple/complex hardware treatment and assurance level.

rows.title: Environmental qualification and installation categories
rows.reference: Applicable MPS and environmental qualification basis
rows.help: Link approved/reviewed requirements, procedures, test reports and qualification summary, covering the actual configuration, installation categories and limitations. DO-160 alone does not establish all product performance requirements.

rows.title: Tool qualification evidence
rows.help: Identify tools whose outputs require qualification and link the agreed qualification data. Document the rationale if no tools require qualification.

rows.title: Supplier evidence, access and oversight arrangements
rows.help: Identify sites, activities, flow-down requirements, evidence acceptance, data/site access and foreign-site coordination. Applicant responsibilities remain with the applicant.

rows.title: Test-article conformity and inspection records
rows.reference: Agreed conformity plan; FAA Forms 8130-9 / 8100-1 as applicable
rows.help: Confirm which conformity requests, statements and inspection records apply. Applicant statements and authority/designee inspection findings have different issuers; link the actual completed records and record their acceptance in the review note.

rows.title: Delegated compliance findings — FAA Form 8110-3
rows.reference: FAA Form 8110-3 when delegated findings are used
rows.help: Import the actual record issued by an authorized designee, with its scope and limitations. ISAF does not issue, sign or authenticate this form. Other delegation arrangements may use different records; explain any not-applicable decision.

rows.title: TSO application, statement of conformance and TSO-specific data
rows.help: Identify the exact TSO/revision and provide the statement of conformance plus every data item required by that TSO. FAA Form 8110-12 is not a general TSO application. Add exact-TSO data requirements to this checklist.

rows.title: TSO / MPS performance compliance evidence
rows.reference: Exact TSO and incorporated minimum performance standards
rows.help: Link performance requirements, procedures, results and configuration applicability, including declared differences and limitations. The certification lead must verify all requirements of the exact TSO.

rows.title: Organization, quality system and quality manual
rows.help: Identify organizational responsibilities, accountable management, design/production interfaces, quality-system procedures and the quality manual submitted for FAA approval. A process template alone is not evidence of an implemented quality system.

rows.title: Installation instructions, limitations and maintenance data
rows.help: Define installation assumptions, limitations, compatibility, required integration verification and maintenance information. A TSO authorization does not authorize installation on an aircraft.

rows.title: Identification, marking and production arrangements
rows.help: Record manufacturing sites, inspection arrangements, article identification/marking and required access to data. Confirm foreign production arrangements with FAA where applicable.

rows.title: Approved TSO deviations
rows.help: If deviating from a TSO requirement, link the actual FAA approval and supporting equivalent-level-of-safety basis. Record a reasoned not-applicable decision if there are no deviations.

rows.title: Non-TSO functions and open problem dispositions
rows.help: Review non-TSO functions, their effects on the TSO function, and all open problem reports. Link accepted dispositions and limitations; explain exclusions.

rows.title: Aircraft integration requirements and delivery agreement
rows.help: Identify aircraft applicant/integrator, basis, allocated requirements, compliance responsibilities and supplier deliverables. An article TSO approval does not replace installation compliance.

rows.title: Aircraft certification application — FAA Form 8110-12
rows.help: Required for the applicable aircraft applicant path as agreed with FAA. A supplier normally delivers evidence to the aircraft applicant; confirm who owns the application and explain exclusions.

rows.title: Installation compliance and integration verification
rows.reference: Aircraft certification plan and allocated requirements
rows.help: Link installation design, safety interfaces, integration verification, performance/environmental compatibility, and applicable test/flight evidence for your assigned scope.

rows.title: Aircraft operating / maintenance / continued-airworthiness data
rows.help: Confirm manuals, ICA and limitations for the installation, including the allocation between supplier and aircraft applicant.

rows.title: Type inspection authorization / inspection reports
rows.reference: FAA TIA and applicable inspection reports
rows.help: Determine which authority authorizations and inspection records apply at the current submission stage. Import actual issued records; supplier delivery sets may exclude records retained by the aircraft applicant.
